thread.title: Pophouse Entertainment Acquires Tina Turner's Name, Image, and Likeness Rights
thread.title_full: Pophouse Entertainment Acquires Tina Turner's Name, Image, and Likeness Rights

author: MARIA SHERMAN - AP Music Writer
title: Pophouse Entertainment Acquires Tina Turner's Name, Image, and Likeness Rights
text:
• Pophouse Entertainment acquired Tina Turner’s name, image, and likeness rights, as well as the majority share of her music catalog rights from BMG.
• Pophouse Entertainment is a Swedish company co-founded by ABBA’s Björn Ulvaeus.
• Turner's catalog includes hits like “What’s Love Got to Do with It,” “The Best,” and “Proud Mary.”
• Turner, known as the “Queen of Rock ‘n’ Roll,” died in May 2023.
• Turner's estate will continue to be involved in the creative and commercial aspects of her legacy.
• The deal includes the creation of digital avatars and immersive experiences.
• In 2022, David Bowie's estate sold his catalog to Warner Chappell Music.
• In 2023, Bruce Springsteen sold his masters and publishing rights to Sony Music Group for a reported $500 million.
• In 2023, Bob Dylan sold his catalog to Universal Music Publishing Group.
summary: NEW YORK (AP) — Pophouse Entertainment has acquired Tina Turner’s name, image and likeness rights as well as the majority share of her music catalog rights from music company BMG, it announced Thursday.
